verdict.rationale: vLLM is hosted as an open GitHub project that documents building from source for development, and its contributing docs section includes a formal project-process policy. That gives only glancing evidence of an open contribution path. missing for 10: a documented contribution guide (PR/review workflow), any path to recognized collaborator or committer/maintainer status, contributor recognition mechanisms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of contributing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can contribute code and become a recognized collaborator through the project's open-source process

citations.quote: Or build from source for development.
